encoder: eldoria-terrain-slicer/2; stdlib PNG RGBA8; filter=0; zlib-level=9

flatteningTransform.diamondOuterBounds: 64x32, two-pixel flat top, rows 0..15 expand by 2px and rows 16..31 contract by 2px
flatteningTransform.name: flatten-raised-block-v1; preserve native RGBA inside inset diamond; alpha=0 for skirt and perimeter
flatteningTransform.sourcePixels: preserved byte-for-byte inside the inset top-face bounds; all other output pixels are transparent

sourceGeometry.maskOrder: explicit mask map; not inferred at runtime
